title: Exercise: best customer
description: Who spent the most on orders that were not cancelled?

input.query: -- Write your query here, then press Run.

exercise.prompt: Find the customer who spent the most in total on orders that were not cancelled. Show the name and the total (quantity * unit_price), one row.
exercise.solution:
SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 1;
